field.label: ReturnSentry URL
field.comment: Address of your ReturnSentry instance, for example https://returnsentry.example.com

field.label: Secret key
field.comment: Starts with rs_sk_. Stored encrypted, used only between Magento and ReturnSentry.

field.label: Publishable key
field.comment: Starts with rs_pk_. Public: the storefront beacon uses it.

field.label: Checkout time budget (ms)
field.comment: Past this delay, the checkout goes on as if ReturnSentry had allowed it. The ReturnSentry panels of orders and customers wait no longer.

field.label: Time budget for other calls (ms)
field.comment: Sync, return assessment and refund authorization. Without an answer in time, the credit memo goes through, unless ReturnSentry last held this refund, or for a claim this order, on fraud evidence.

field.label: Checkout decisions
field.comment: Observe: each order is assessed and shows what ReturnSentry would have done, with no effect. Enforce: "Review" flags the order, "Restricted payment" hides the risky payment methods chosen below (at least one method stays available), "Block" (operator decision only) refuses the order with a neutral message.

field.label: Return assessment
field.comment: Assesses each new return and shows the decision on the order. It never blocks the legal withdrawal.

field.label: Refund authorization
field.comment: Asks ReturnSentry before every credit memo refunding a return or a parcel claim. Observe: the answer shows on the order, the credit memo is never stopped. Enforce: a hold or a denial stops the credit memo, unless an administrator allowed to override refunds anyway with a reason; if ReturnSentry does not answer, the credit memo goes through except after a hold on fraud evidence.

field.label: Beacon
field.comment: Loads the ReturnSentry device beacon on the storefront, following the Beacon section below.

field.label: Payment methods excluded from control
field.comment: Methods whose payment and refunds an external checkout handles, such as Global-e. Placing an order paid with one of them is neither assessed nor stopped, and its credit memos ask no refund authorization. The payment method list, computed before any method is chosen, is still assessed like any cart's. Orders are still sent to ReturnSentry. Global-e (globale) by default.

field.label: Risky payment methods
field.comment: Deferred, pay later, split or cash on delivery methods to hide when ReturnSentry restricts payment, with checkout decisions enforced. None by default.

field.label: Pseudonymize personal data
field.comment: Sends a hashed email and address and phone fingerprints instead of clear values, and no IP address. ReturnSentry then shows tokens instead of emails.

field.label: Pseudonymization secret
field.comment: At least 32 characters, never changed once data has been sent. Use the same secret as any history export.

field.label: Return reasons
field.comment: Your return reason labels or codes, in every language, and their standard reason. Unknown labels count as "No reason". A customer return stays a customer return whatever its reason, even "not collected": only a parcel the carrier brought back uncollected is a return to sender, and it never comes from this table.

field.label: Credit memo reason code field
field.comment: Optional. Name of the credit memo field that holds your refund reason code, when your shop has one.

field.label: Credit memo reason codes
field.comment: Your refund reason codes and their standard category. A code missing from this list counts as "Other".

field.label: Credit memo on an order with a return
Credit memo with no item, adjustment only
Credit memo on an order not shipped
Credit memo on a shipped order without return
field.comment: Other by default: such a refund is checked as a parcel claim only when you choose a claim category here or map its credit memo code. Returns reach the check through Adobe Commerce RMA or ReturnReporterInterface. Refund authorization applies to returns, parcels returned to sender, claims and evidence categories, never to the neutral ones.

group.label: Beacon
group.comment: In France and the European Union, reading the device needs the visitor's consent, except to secure sign-in. Wire your consent manager as described in the module README.

field.label: Consent cookie
field.comment: Optional. Name of the cookie your consent manager sets.

field.label: Consent cookie value
field.comment: Required with a consent cookie. A whole token of the cookie, between , ; | & or spaces, that means consent: returnsentry for Axeptio's authorized vendors, C0004:1 for an accepted OneTrust group. A name alone, such as C0004, also matches C0004:1, C0004=1 or C0004:true, never C0004:0. Didomi encodes its cookie: use the consent event.

field.label: Consent event
field.comment: Browser event on window: detail true grants consent, detail false withdraws it.
